newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 38.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia 6-mth T-bill yield falls to 38.10 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills fell to 38.10 percent at an auction on Wednesday from 45.01 percent at the previous auction on November 20, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the issue would yield between 35.02-42.16 percent annual.
Full details of the issue follow.
Issue volume 7.00 trln rbls 8.00 trln rbls
NOTE - Although the bills run for more than nine months, they are officially classified as six-month paper.

On Wednesday, the finance ministry also raised 2.11 trillion roubles by selling 2.10 trillion roubles in a new tranche of two-year OFZ interest-bearing bond (series 24003), taking total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to six trillion roubles.

The finance ministry has repaid about 4.95 trillion roubles of maturing six-month T-bills (series 22034) and is paying total interest of about 1.05 trillion roubles on OFZ bonds (series 24003 and 24004).
